title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300M
summary: OpenAI has reportedly acquired Glass Imaging, a smartphone camera technology company, for $300 million, marking another significant strategic acquisition as the AI company expands its hardware and imaging capabilities.
problem_solved: Strategic expansion of AI imaging capabilities through acquisition of specialized camera technology expertise
why_valuable: Brings advanced smartphone camera technology and talent to enhance OpenAI's multimodal AI and potential hardware ambitions
